title: Engineering of glycyrrhizin-loaded chitosan nanogel for pulmonary immunomodulation via regulation of NF-kappaB signaling and macrophage polarization in lung inflammatory.
authors: Liu, Yanjun; Al-Hakeem, Maher Abdulrazzaq; Almajidi, Yasir Qasim; Yaseen, Ahmed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草酸壳聚糖纳米凝胶的肺部免疫调节作用，虽涉及NF-kappaB信号通路，但核心是纳米药物递送与炎症调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，仅MD模拟验证纳米凝胶稳定性，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acute lung injury involves excessive inflammation, neutrophil infiltration, and impaired macrophage polarization, underscoring the need for effective immunomodulatory therapies. Here, we developed a glycyrrhizin-loaded chitosan nanogel (GlyU@CS) as a biocompatible macromolecular platform for targeted modulation of pulmonary inflammation. MD simulations verified the structural stability of the nanogel under physiological conditions. Physicochemical analyses confirmed its nanoscale size (57 nm), positive charge (+24.8 +/- 1.7 mV), amorphous structure, and efficient GlyU loading. In vitro mucoadhesion assays revealed strong electrostatic interactions with mucin, reflected by increases in hydrodynamic diameter (145.3 --> 257 nm) and reduced zeta potential (+24 --> +8.7 mV), along with notable rheological synergism, collectively indicating enhanced mucus retention. Cellular studies demonstrated minimal hemolysis (<2%), efficient uptake, and markedly reduced intracellular ROS relative to free GlyU. In LPS-stimulated murine cells, GlyU@CS significantly suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokine expression at both mRNA and protein levels. In an LPS-induced acute lung injury model, the nanogel markedly alleviated inflammation, including a reduction in MPO activity from 2.5 to 1 mU/mg, diminished neutrophil infiltration, and pronounced histopathological improvement. Mechanistically, the nanogel exerted strong anti-inflammatory activity by inhibiting NF-kappaB signaling, reducing COX-2 and iNOS, and restoring IkappaB-alpha. Flow cytometry further confirmed a 7.5-fold shift in macrophage polarization from pro-inflammatory M1 to anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype. Overall, GlyU@CS acts as a potent immunomodulatory system integrating mucoadhesive delivery with molecular regulation of inflammation and macrophage polarization, highlighting the promise of CS-based nanogels for treating acute lung inflammatory disorders.
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤涉及过度炎症、中性粒细胞浸润及巨噬细胞极化受损，凸显了对有效免疫调节疗法的需求。在此，我们开发了一种负载甘草酸（glycyrrhizin）的壳聚糖纳米凝胶（GlyU@CS），作为生物相容性大分子平台，用于靶向调节肺部炎症。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟验证了该纳米凝胶在生理条件下的结构稳定性。理化分析确认其纳米级尺寸（57 nm）、正电荷（+24.8 +/- 1.7 mV）、无定形结构及高效的GlyU负载。体外黏膜粘附实验揭示了与黏蛋白的强静电相互作用，表现为流体动力学直径增加（145.3 --> 257 nm）及zeta电位降低（+24 --> +8.7 mV），同时伴随显著的流变协同效应，共同表明黏液滞留能力增强。细胞研究显示，与游离GlyU相比，其溶血率极低（<2%）、摄取效率高，且细胞内活性氧显著减少。在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的小鼠细胞中，GlyU@CS在mRNA和蛋白水平均显著抑制促炎细胞因子表达。在LPS诱导的急性肺损伤模型中，该纳米凝胶显著缓解炎症，包括将髓过氧化物酶（MPO）活性从2.5降至1 mU/mg、减少中性粒细胞浸润，并表现出明显的组织病理学改善。机制上，该纳米凝胶通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路、降低COX-2和iNOS表达及恢复IkappaB-alpha水平，发挥强效抗炎活性。流式细胞术进一步证实，巨噬细胞极化从促炎M1型向抗炎M2型转变了7.5倍。总体而言，GlyU@CS作为一种强效免疫调节系统，将黏膜粘附递送与炎症及巨噬细胞极化的分子调控相结合，凸显了基于CS的纳米凝胶在治疗急性肺部炎症性疾病中的潜力。
